accepted_residual_cases: Provider-origin automated role with one named actor reveals that software actor, not a protected stratum.
Provider-origin automated family with one resource can reveal that resource count.
Historical robots_control and undeclared_bucket daily exceptions were release decisions, not anonymizing properties; no new protected daily exception applies.
Already public historical releases remain accessible. No claim of universal anonymity or erasure.

actor_names_at_edition_level.scope: Named software-agent families (for example GPTBot) are published as actor names at edition level only; day-level outputs never carry an actor name.

amendments.change: Protected strata combined in the daily grain; the failed-verification tier added to the protected strata, as its definition requires; user-initiated fetches removed from daily series (G01 and the main.daily metrics); undeclared bucket and non-protected single-path strata listed as accepted residual cases; differencing argument corrected.
amendments.effect_on_results: No edition-level count changes; the main result, the role split and the scope delta are unchanged. Daily views now count automated roles only.
amendments.reason: A crossing check on the candidate edition found three protected daily strata whose edition cells covered a single path, so the day of those requests to that path could be recovered by crossing daily-summary.csv with consultations.csv (one of them a single user-initiated fetch).

complementary_suppression: coverage daily totals and differences withheld together with protected daily rows

daily_protected_group.label: protected_strata
daily_protected_group.minimum_paths_rule: Historical diagnostic only, not a non-reconstruction criterion.
daily_protected_group.rule: Historical grouped rows are retained only in frozen r1. Current projection withholds protected daily rows and coverage complements.

differencing_argument: The former edition-wide path threshold does not prove non-reconstruction. New fine protected cells require a complete inventoried public history and an assessed combination. Unassessed combinations are blocked; no general anonymity guarantee. Existing public cells may be re-presented exactly, never silently revised.
forbidden_combinations: day x actor_role, stored tier, method or status for any protected stratum
day x family for any protected stratum
user_initiated_fetch in any daily series, figure or metric

grains.strata: only non-protected strata; protected rows and all coverage complements are withheld
main documentary population, provider-origin tier, roles ai_training and ai_search only

protected_strata.description: Strata that may contain requests initiated by a person: user-initiated fetches, and unattributed, unverified or failed-verification clients whose stored label cannot exclude a browser.

structural_exclusions: per-path first and last access dates
